basic_details.job_title: DRDO CABS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Consultant, Consultant Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Airborne Systems (CABS), Bengaluru, under the Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO), Ministry of Defence, is engaging three retired officials from Central Government, State Government, PSU or autonomous bodies as Consultants on a contract of one year, extendable as per norms. The posts are one Technical (Post Code 2026/CABS/341, Pay Level 13/13A at retirement) and two Admin (2026/CABS/342 and 2026/CABS/343). Applications go by post to the Director, CABS or by email to [email protected] and must be received by 17 Dec 2026.

content_sections.heading: About DRDO CABS
content_sections.text: CABS is a Bengaluru establishment of the Defence Research & Development Organisation, Ministry of Defence, Government of India. The notice describes it as a lab whose work includes the AEW&C Mk-1A programme, a Budget & Accounts Division and a Works Division. The Consultants are engaged for these specific jobs, as per each post's Terms of Reference (TOR).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must have retired from Central or State Governments, PSUs, Autonomous Bodies, Universities or Government R&D Organisations, at the pay level shown for the post. They need practical knowledge and adequate experience in the field of the post, as per the TOR. Other conditions for all posts: Effective oral and written communication and interpersonal skills, with a strong flair for in-depth examination of the area of work. An unblemished service record. A gap of fifteen (15) days between retirement and appointment as consultant. Age not more than 63 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. Experience of having worked with DRDO is accorded preference during selection/appointment. For Post 343 the TOR also says the person should have worked at least at a supervisory level in a Government department dealing with works services and admin, and be comfortable in a computerised office. The notice does not specify the age limit separately by post; the 63-year limit applies to all. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification_and_experience: Engineering Graduate (BE/B Tech) with experience in DRDO Project Management (Airborne Related)
rows.desirable: Knowledge of Defence Programmes/Project execution and procedures; preferably conversant with procedures as per DPEM

rows.essential_qualification_and_experience: Graduate in any discipline and prior experience in procurements / Accounts (Pay & Equipment) / Govt. Audit with computer knowledge is essential
rows.desirable: Preferably conversant with Audit, Accounts (Pay & Equipment), Delegation of Financial Power, GFR and computer knowledge
Working experience in the field of civil works services will be preferred

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The amount stays unchanged for the term of the contract, with no annual increment or percentage increase. Remuneration for a month is payable in the subsequent month. A consultant continues to draw pension and dearness relief on pension, and the engagement is not a case of re-employment. Consultants are not entitled to Dearness Allowance, transport facility, residential accommodation, personal staff, CGHS, medical reimbursement or telephone/internet reimbursement. TA/DA is admissible for official travel within the country, at the rate for the pay level from which the person retired. Paid leave is 1.5 days for each completed month of service, with no accumulation beyond a calendar year. The engagement is for one year from the date of engagement, extendable for one year as per norms.

rows.remuneration: A fixed monthly amount, arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement
rows.conveyance_allowance: Rs. 3,000/- up to pay level 11; Rs. 5,000/- for pay level 12 and above

content_sections.heading: DRDO CABS Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist the Programme Director, AEW&C Mk-1A programme and DCPP at CABS in the technical domain and in programme management, including Quality Management. Carry out pre-project activities for the DAC-approved AEW&C Mk-1A programme across the life cycle of the programme. Carry out all required coordination, administrative work for DCPP and programme management activities. Should have command over preparation of GANTT charts, CCS note, cost and time estimation and project proposals, and be well versed with the Engineering Life Cycle Management tool and project management tools. The notice says the activities may take a minimum of two years, and the term is likely to be extended depending on contingencies of the programme. Proper accounting of all the inventories of the lab. Audit correspondences and follow-up with both users and audit authorities. Annual verification of inventories. MIS reports in respect of audit and equipment accounting. The post is for the Budget & Accounts Division (B&AD), including correspondence with CDA(R&D), other audit agencies (Test Audit and LAO) and user divisions. The proposal is initially for 1 year and the term is likely to be extended depending on procurement activities. Monitoring and coordination of Capital, Revenue and maintenance works. Processing of works cases, estimates and related documentation. Liaison with MES, EMU, BESCOM, BWSSB, HAL, CCE(R&D), CGWB and other external agencies. Supervision and maintenance of repair and maintenance activities. Monitoring of essential services such as conservancy, arboriculture, pest control, AMC of RO water purifiers and other maintenance activities. Assistance in administrative processing and accounting procedures for works services. Monitoring of timelines for timely completion of works and maintenance activities. Liaison with civil authorities (HAL) on land acquisition and payment of lease rentals for land on lease to CABS. Follow the official timings of CABS. Supervision of all ongoing and future works activities and follow-up till tender/contract action and completion of work. This engagement is for the Works Division and is not against any vacant post. It is on full-time basis, and the consultant shall not be permitted to undertake any other assignment during the consultancy. The activities may continue for a minimum of two years, and the term may be extended as required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DRDO CABS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Identity proof Proof of Address Copy of P.P.O Copy of proofs of Educational qualification Copy of Service Verification Certificate Appendix A asks for name in block letters, date of superannuation, designation and pay level at superannuation, last organisation served, date of birth, age as on closing date, gender, correspondence address and contact details, education from graduation onwards, areas of research (scientific/technical posts) or area of specialization (admin posts), a complete record of services, list of published books/papers (scientific/technological posts only), knowledge of computers and any other relevant information.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received by the closing date are first scrutinised for basic eligibility and the TOR by a locally-constituted Committee. A duly-constituted Screening Committee then assesses suitability and short-lists applicants, keeping in view the eligibility criteria, TOR, GFR provisions and relevant guidelines. The merit-wise panel recommended by the Screening Committee, including wait-listed candidates, is valid for six months. The Offer of Appointment is issued by the Directorate of Personnel, DRDO HQ, after approval of the Competent Authority. The notice does not describe an interview or a test. On receiving the offer, the consultant must submit a Letter of Consent, Contract Agreement, Non-Disclosure Agreement and an undertaking accepting the terms of the offer. Before the Contract Agreement is executed, the employing office verifies documents such as PPO, Medical Fitness Certificate and Police Verification. The Contract Agreement and Non-Disclosure Agreement are signed on a Non-Judicial Stamp Paper of Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DRDO CABS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 Consultant vacancies: one Technical (2026/CABS/341) and two Admin (2026/CABS/342 and 2026/CABS/343).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 17 Dec 2026. Late applications are rejected without intimation.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the DRDO CABS Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Retired officials of Central Government, State Government, PSUs or autonomous bodies who retired at the pay level prescribed for the post, with an unblemished service record and a 15-day gap between retirement and appointment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for each post?
faq.answer: Post 341 needs an Engineering Graduate (BE/B Tech) with DRDO project management experience (airborne related). Posts 342 and 343 need graduation in any discipline; 342 also needs experience in procurements/accounts/audit with computer knowledge.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must not be more than 63 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay of a DRDO CABS Consultant?
faq.answer: Non-pensioners get Rs. 60,000 (Level 13/13A), Rs. 30,000 / Rs. 40,000 respectively (Level 7/8) or Rs. 30,000 (Level 7). Pensioners get a fixed amount of pay at retirement minus basic pension. Conveyance allowance is Rs. 3,000 or Rs. 5,000 by pay level.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send Appendix A with Appendix B and the supporting documents to The Director, Centre for Airborne Systems, Belur, Yemalur Post, Bengaluru – 560037, or email [email protected], with the subject "Application for Consultant (Post Code No.…)".

faq.question: Q8. How are Consultants selected?
faq.answer: A local committee checks eligibility and the TOR, then a Screening Committee short-lists applicants. A merit-wise panel valid for six months is prepared, and the Offer of Appointment is issued by the Directorate of Personnel, DRDO HQ.

faq.question: Q9. Is the DRDO CABS Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary (non-official) contract for one year, extendable for one year as per norms, with no right to absorption or regularization.

faq.question: Q10. Can a Consultant keep drawing pension?
faq.answer: Yes. A retired official appointed as consultant continues to draw pension and dearness relief on pension, and the engagement is not re-employment.
